notes:
v4.6.75 — Marketplace universe badge + Manual fund reserve

✨ NEW
• Bot Market cards now show a universe badge: 🌐 <NAME> when a bot trades a curated public universe (e.g. LONG_TERM, SEMICONDUCTORS), or 🎯 OWN PICKS when the bot chooses its own tickers. New bots you publish are tagged automatically from their META.
• IBKR allocation now has a fixed “✋ MANUAL (reserve)” row. Set a % to hold back a slice of your IBKR cash for your own hand-placed trades — bots are seeded from cash net of the reserve, so they leave it alone. Default 0 = no reserve, nothing changes.

🧱 ALSO
• Manual trading already runs on its own dedicated Alpaca account (separate from every bot) — the new reserve adds the same idea on the IBKR side.
• A universe can never be deleted out from under a bot: public universes are server-managed, and nothing in the app deletes a universe a bot depends on.

Update via the in-app banner.
